req.title: load_logged_in_user populates g.user
req.statement: The system shall populate flask.g.user with the User row for the authenticated session on every request.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should populate flask.g.user with the User row for the authenticated session on every request. This behavior needs to be verified through positive, negative, and boundary test cases to ensure robustness and correctness of the implementation.

tests.name: test_load_logged_in_user_positive
preconditions: User is registered and logged in
actions: Make a request to any endpoint
expected: flask.g.user is populated with the correct User row
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Register and login
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})

# Make a request to trigger load_logged_in_user
with client:
    r = client.get('/hello')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert g.user['username'] == 'test'
    assert g.user['id'] == 1

tests.name: test_load_logged_in_user_negative
actions: Make a request to any endpoint
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app

tests.name: test_load_logged_in_user_boundary
preconditions: User is registered and logged in
actions: Make a request to any endpoint
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Register and login
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'test', 'password': 'test'})

# Clear session to test boundary condition
with client.session_transaction() as sess:
    sess.clear()

# Make a request to trigger load_logged_in_user
with client:
    r = client.get('/hello')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert g.user is None
